title: Getting together
text: My grandparents held me when it was dark.
They played with me in the park.
They took me to school over the years.
When I cried, they dried my tears.
I love to visit my grandparents' home
So they know they are not alone.
I tidy their home and help them shop.
My love for them will never stop.
